driving"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" the app's own GUI over Chrome DevTools Protocol, not by pretending it is an API key."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It ships three things:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Piece | What it does |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| `bridge/zcode-bridge.mjs` | Local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`POST /v1/chat/completions`) that ty"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"pes a prompt into the running ZCode window, waits for the turn to finish, and returns the answer; th"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"e plugin ships this same file and starts it on demand |
| plugin `dsh-zcode-connect` | Host half wit"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"h three loopback routes (status JSON, the HTML panel, and an on-demand bridge start) plus a client h"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"alf that puts the panel in DSH's right sidebar as a tab — account, plan, live quota, loaded capabili"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ties, what this connector installed, and what the client is running in the background right now |
| "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"`mcp/server.mjs` | MCP stdio server exposing status, background runs, ask, and provisioning tools to"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" any MCP client (DSH consumes it through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why drive the GUI instead of using an API key"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Measured on a real install, not inferred:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- ZCode's promo grants (for example `ZCode Weekend Build`, 300,000,000 `GLM-5.3-Flash` tokens) are
d"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"eclared in the client's own catalog as **account-bound**:
`"access": { "type": "zhipu-account", "mod"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e": "start-plan" }`. **There is no API key to extract.**
- The only inference route for such a grant"},{"id":"p9s4","text":",
`POST https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/anthropic/v1/messages`, accepts the account token but
a"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"nswers `{"code":3007,"msg":"captcha verify failed"}` without `X-Aliyun-Captcha-Verify-Param` —
an Al"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"iyun traceless-captcha proof minted **per request inside ZCode's renderer**.
- The documented platfo"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"rm routes do not carry the grant: with the same account,
`https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic` an"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"d `/api/coding/paas/v4` answer
`{"code":"1113","message":"余额不足或无可用资源包,请充值。"}`, and the ZCode account"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" token is `401`
on `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"So the way to reach that quota from your own tooling is to **let the first-party client make the
cal"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"l** and drive its UI. That is what this project does — and it is the reason the grant is
reachable h"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ve its UI. That is what this project does — and it is the reason the grant is
reachable here at all."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Watching what the client runs in the background"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"When ZCode works, it works **inside its own process**: the primary agent spawns subagents, runs tool"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"
calls, and keeps going on its own. Nothing about that reaches the harness that asked for it — DSH's"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"
own sidebar lists DSH's subagents and jobs, and it cannot see the ones running in another
applicati"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"on. The connector therefore reads the client's own state files and renders them into its
panel (and "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"over MCP), so the run is visible while it happens:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Shown | Meaning |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| running subagents | role, the task it was given, the tool it is executing **right now** (with its "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"target path), elapsed time, turns, tool calls, tokens |
| finished subagents | outcome (`done` / `pa"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"rtial` / `blocked`), duration, tokens, tool count, the `CHANGED:` / `FAILED:` item list from its own"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"), duration, tokens, tool count, the `CHANGED:` / `FAILED:` item list from its own report |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- ZCode desktop, launched with a debug port: `ZCode.exe --remote-debugging-port=9333`
(it must be **"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"running**, but it does not need to be visible or in the foreground — minimised,
covered, or on anoth"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"er virtual desktop all work; only closing it breaks the bridge)
- Node.js 20+ (the bridge and MCP se"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"rver use the built-in `fetch`)
- DeepSeek Harness, if you want the plugin half"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Operating requirements (all measured)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **The client must be running** with the debug port. It does **not** need to be in the foreground:
"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"minimised, behind other windows, or unfocused all work, because events are delivered to the
renderer"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" rather than to the OS window.
- **Window geometry is free.** The OS window is never read, moved or "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"resized; the bridge attaches to the
renderer page inside it. For the duration of one request the pag"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"e's layout viewport is frozen at the
window's *current* size (and device pixel ratio) so a target ca"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"nnot drift between being measured and
being clicked, and it is released when the request ends — a pe"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"r-request freeze, not a resize of your
window.
- **Serial**: one conversation, one input box. The br"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"idge queues; it does not parallelise.
- **The bridge is a separate process, and this plugin owns it."},{"id":"p18s9","text":"** `bridgeMode` decides whether it is
started on demand (default), at load, or never; a bridge that "},{"id":"p18s10","text":"was already running is reused, and one
this plugin did not start is never stopped.
- **One new task "},{"id":"p18s11","text":"per call** — the client keeps no history between calls, so send full context.
- **Channel must be `S"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"tart Plan`.** The bridge checks the composer's model label every call and
switches it if it reads th"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"e metered `bigmodel-api/…` channel instead.
- **UTF-8 required** by callers; the OpenAI SDK path is "},{"id":"p18s14","text":"fine, PowerShell 5.1's `-Body <string>` is not.
- **Latency**: 14–20 s for a short reply, ~100 s for"},{"id":"p18s15","text":" a fan-out batch. `toolCallTimeoutMs` should be
generous. A turn spent thinking at the highest level"},{"id":"p18s16","text":" can exceed any fixed budget while the client
keeps working — `zcode_runs` (or the panel) shows that"},{"id":"p18s17","text":" run continuing.
- **The client is an agent, not a bare model**: with a project open, a prompt may e"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"dit files. Keep
its workspace empty while using this as a model channel.
- **Quota accounting is not"},{"id":"p18s19","text":" exposed per call** — `usage` is reported as zero. Read the panel, or the
client's own usage page."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Privacy"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The connector reads the client's own credential file (`~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json`) to query the
p"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"lan API. That value is used as a bearer token in one request and **never** appears in a response,
a "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"log line, or the panel — the account section reports only an identity and a token *length*. The
self"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"-check asserts this (`status JSON does not contain the account token`,
`panel HTML does not contain "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"the account token`)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The background-run view follows the same rule: it reports a run's role, status, timings, counts,
cha"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nged paths and its own report — not the prompt it was given and not its system prompt. The
self-chec"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"k asserts that too (`no prompt text leaks into the snapshot`)."}],"truncated":true}
